title: Siwei Jianghuang Decoction mitigates diabetic nephropathy by suppressing oxidative stress, inflammation and apoptosis via the inhibition of the NOX-4/NF-kappaB/MCP-1 pathway.
authors: Liu, Jia; Yu, Peiling; Lai, Xianrong; Zhang, Shuwan; Zhao, Qing; Yang, Ming; Wang, Jing; Ai, Xiaopeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究藏药四味姜黄汤对糖尿病肾病的保护作用，涉及NF-kappaB通路和分子对接，但核心是疾病药理而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Siwei Jianghuang Decoction (SWJHD), a renowned Tibetan medicine formula in China, has the effect of balancing "three factors" and serves as a viable therapeutic option for managing diabetes mellitus and its complications, including diabetic nephropathy (DN). However, the underlying mechanism behind its therapeutic actions remains to be fully elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: The current study was designed to investigate the protective effects of SWJHD on renal tissues of rats with high fat and high glucose diet (HFD) and streptozotocin (STZ)-induced DN. Additionally, it explored the mechanism of SWJHD in combating oxidative stress, inflammation and apoptosis via inhibition of the NOX-4/NF-kappaB/MCP-1 pathway. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Firstly, the representative components in the water extract of SWJHD were detected using HPLC. The beneficial effects of SWJHD were analyzed by examining FBG levels, renal function indicators (such as Scr, BUN, and urinary protein levels), pathological changes, oxidative stress markers, and inflammatory cytokines, and apoptosis-related indicators in renal tissues of DN rats following gavage with different SWJHD doses (0.63 g/kg and 1.26 g/kg). Subsequently, molecular docking was utilized to discover the potential associations between representative components of SWJHD and oxidative stress/apoptosis-related proteins. Furthermore, the expression levels of genes and proteins in renal tissues, including NOX-4, NF-kappaB, MCP-1, Bax, Bcl-2, Cyto-c, and cleaved Caspase3 were estimated by PCR, immunofluorescence analyses, and Western blot. RESULTS: Phytochemical profiling demonstrated that curcumin, berberine, palmatine, jatrorrhizine, ellagic acid, magnoflorine, and gallic acid were principally representative ingredients in SWJHD. The results confirmed that SWJHD administration attenuated DN, as evidenced by decreased levels of FBG, MDA, MPO, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta and IL-6. It also effectively improved OGTT, increased the levels of GSH, GSH-PX, and SOD, as well as reduced the abnormal renal index, ameliorated renal histopathology and ultrastructure, and reduced the number of apoptotic cells in the kidney. The molecular docking results indicated that the principal constituents of SWJHD and proteins related to oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis had potentially reactive sites. Additionally, SWJHD treatment suppressed the expression of NOX-4, MCP-1, and NF-kappaB genes and proteins. Meanwhile, SWJHD significantly reduced the apoptosis, inhibited the up-regulation of Bax, Cyto-c, and cleaved Caspase-3 at both the gene and protein levels, and increased in the level of Bcl-2 in the retinal tissues of DN rats. CONCLUSIONS: SWJHD may afford a protective intervention in DN rats by suppressing the oxidative stress, inflammation and apoptosis via inhibition of the NOX-4/NF-kappaB/MCP-1 pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：四味姜黄汤（SWJHD）是中国一种著名的藏药方剂，具有平衡“三因”的功效，是治疗糖尿病及其并发症（包括糖尿病肾病（DN））的可行治疗选择。然而，其治疗作用背后的潜在机制仍有待充分阐明。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨SWJHD对高脂高糖饮食（HFD）和链脲佐菌素（STZ）诱导的DN大鼠肾组织的保护作用。此外，还探讨了SWJHD通过抑制NOX-4/NF-kappaB/MCP-1通路来对抗氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡的机制。材料与方法：首先，采用高效液相色谱法（HPLC）检测SWJHD水提取物中的代表性成分。通过灌胃不同剂量SWJHD（0.63 g/kg和1.26 g/kg）后，分析DN大鼠的空腹血糖（FBG）水平、肾功能指标（如Scr、BUN和尿蛋白水平）、病理变化、氧化应激标志物、炎症细胞因子及凋亡相关指标，以评估SWJHD的有益作用。随后，利用分子对接技术探索SWJHD代表性成分与氧化应激/凋亡相关蛋白之间的潜在关联。此外，通过PCR、免疫荧光分析和Western blot评估肾组织中基因和蛋白的表达水平，包括NOX-4、NF-kappaB、MCP-1、Bax、Bcl-2、Cyto-c和cleaved Caspase3。结果：植物化学分析表明，姜黄素、小檗碱、巴马汀、药根碱、鞣花酸、木兰花碱和没食子酸是SWJHD中的主要代表性成分。结果证实，SWJHD给药可减轻DN，表现为FBG、MDA、MPO、TNF-alpha、IL-1beta和IL-6水平降低。它还有效改善了口服葡萄糖耐量试验（OGTT），增加了GSH、GSH-PX和SOD的水平，同时降低了异常的肾脏指数，改善了肾组织病理学和超微结构，并减少了肾脏中凋亡细胞的数量。分子对接结果表明，SWJHD的主要成分与氧化应激、炎症和凋亡相关蛋白具有潜在的反应位点。此外，SWJHD治疗抑制了NOX-4、MCP-1和NF-kappaB基因和蛋白的表达。同时，SWJHD显著减少了细胞凋亡，在基因和蛋白水平上抑制了Bax、Cyto-c和cleaved Caspase-3的上调，并增加了DN大鼠肾组织中Bcl-2的水平。结论：SWJHD可能通过抑制NOX-4/NF-kappaB/MCP-1通路来抑制氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡，从而为DN大鼠提供保护性干预。
